name: Hilal Seal
summary: An asymmetric crescent embraces a bold eight-point star, bringing lunar time and Islamic ornament into one luminous mark.
why: The broad ivory crescent gives the mark a calm sweeping movement. A gold geometric star rests in its open space, with a diamond cutout keeping the center light. The offset composition makes it feel more fluid than a conventional centered badge.
risk: It suggests the Islamic calendar and Ramadan more immediately than prayer scheduling. Crescent-and-star symbolism is familiar across many Islamic identities.
reasonToChoose: A graceful and immediately Islamic symbol should lead.

palette.name: HILAL SEAL / NIGHT INDIGO + IVORY + SAFFRON
